title: Services
subtitle: Architecture that spans technology, data and the operating model — designed for complex and regulated environments, built to leave the whiteboard.

offerings.title: From direction to shipped outcomes
offerings.text: I translate goals into an executable plan: scope, roadmap, risks, dependencies, and a delivery cadence that actually works.

offerings.title: Design what works, build what's needed
offerings.text: Technology, data and the operating model, designed together: clear boundaries, integrations, and the decisions and delivery flow that make the design work in practice.

offerings.title: Security and compliance by design
offerings.text: Information security, data governance and auditability as part of the architecture, not a control added at the end. Proven under eIDAS and ISO 27001, backed by CISSP.

engagements.title: Build an operating model
engagements.text: Processes, tooling and a line organization that's transferable.

engagements.title: Product & platform
engagements.text: From roadmap to implementation and operations.

engagements.title: Identity & access architecture
